slides.title: Hybi's 1-minute recovery plan
slides.sub: For the day of your walk and after

sections.heading: 1. After a big walk
lines: ① Drink plenty of water and eat a decent meal.
② On the drive home, stretch your legs hourly.
③ Next morning, 10–15 min easy walk.
④ A remedial massage a day or two later can help.

sections.heading: 2. See a GP or physio if…
lines: A calf swells, or one spot is sharply sore —
get it checked rather than massaged.

caption:
Great day on the track, then the stairs at home feel impossible? That was Koko after a big coastal walk.

Descending asks your quads and calves to brake with every step, so soreness often peaks a day or two later. A remedial massage can ease tightness and help you move more comfortably, though research suggests it mainly helps how sore you feel.

The bigger win is preparation: hills and stairs in the weeks before. A swollen calf or pain that keeps getting worse is worth a GP or physio check.
